events.name: DISABLED
events.text: You have a terrible accident which almost cripples you. Your Movement Allowance values should always be read from the line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: WIMP
events.text: In frightening situations you tend to pass out. Your Actions/Round value should always be read from the line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: WEAK BONE STRUCTURE
events.text: Subtract 3 from your maximum HP.

events.name: DIMWITTED
events.text: Your Defensive and Perception Bonuses should always be read one line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: SERIOUS CRIME COMMITTED
events.text: Guilty or not, you are sentenced for a serious crime and spend years in a labor camp. It hardens the body and dulls the rest: +1 STR and CON, −1 INT and CHA, −5 Credit Score, criminal record.

events.name: MINOR CRIME COMMITTED
events.text: You are found guilty of a minor crime and spend 1d3 years in prison: +1 STR, −1 CON, −3 Credit Score, criminal record.

events.name: CRIMINAL RECORD
events.text: You've taken part in some criminal activity and your name is recorded in criminal records—probably for the rest of your life.

events.name: BAD COMPANY
events.text: Unfortunately you've spent a lot of time in the wrong company. -1 to Credit Score (1 is the minimum).

events.name: TRAGIC ACCIDENT
events.text: Both your parents died in a terrible accident and you were sent to an orphanage. −3 Credit Score; grief hardens you: +1 MST.

events.name: ISOLATED UPBRINGING
events.text: Raised in a restrictive, sheltered household: more books than people. +1 INT, −1 CHA. The family pays your way into school: one entry roll for a Student career is waived.

events.name: SPOILED HEIR
events.text: Born into old money with heavy family strings attached. +3 Credit Score, −1 MST (nobody ever tested you). A family call opens a door: one entry roll is waived.

events.name: MILITARY HERITAGE
events.text: Spend two years in a military academy: you get its credential.

events.name: TECHNICAL TALENT
events.text: Spend two years in a technical university: you get its credential.

events.name: BUSINESS FAMILY
events.text: Attend a business school for two years: you get its credential.

events.name: MEDIA FAMILY
events.text: Enroll in a media college for two years: you get its credential.

events.name: MILITARY CONNECTIONS
events.text: You have the right connections within the military: you ignore all Officer requirements and never roll to enter or stay.

events.name: APPRENTICE SCIENTIST
events.text: A lab took you in early: you ignore all Scientist requirements and never roll to enter or stay.

events.name: AMATEUR PHOTOGRAPHER/WRITER
events.text: Your work already gets published: you ignore all Reporter requirements and never roll to enter or stay.

events.name: BUSINESS SENSE
events.text: You have a head for money and the people who move it: you ignore all Administration / Economy / Law requirements and never roll to enter or stay.

events.name: RESTLESS DRIFTER
events.text: Spent your youth bouncing from sector to sector, never settling down long enough to put down roots, or finish a school year. +1 WIS, −1 INT.

events.name: STREET HUSTLER
events.text: Grew up learning survival tricks on the blocks, relying on street smarts rather than formal structure. +1 CHA, −1 INT.

events.name: SLICK SPEAKER
events.text: Excel at reading pressure points and driving negotiations under stress. Add +1 to CHA.

events.name: NATURAL TECHNICIAN
events.text: Innate grasp of hardware, lock mechanics and electronic systems; less time outdoors. +1 INT, −1 STR.

events.name: SLENDER BODY
events.text: Move with natural grace agility and speed through tight physical spaces. Add +1 to DEX.

events.name: WEAPONS FANATIC
events.text: Intuitive understanding of ballistics, firearm mechanics and recoil control; people find you a little odd. +1 DEX, −1 CHA.

events.name: MARTIAL ARTS TRAINING
events.text: Formal training in close-quarters defense and hand-to-hand, instead of homework. +1 STR, +1 DEX, −1 INT.

events.name: ANATOMICAL SIXTH SENSE
events.text: Hit people where it hurts most. Add +1 to your Offensive Bonus row.

events.name: SHARP SENSES
events.text: Exceptional situational awareness reacting to ambient threats. Add +1 to WIS.

events.name: STRONG WILL
events.text: Nothing breaks you easily. +1 MST.

events.name: CHARISMATIC VOICE
events.text: People listen when you talk. +1 CHA.

events.name: GOOD BODY CONTROL
events.text: You know your body and keep it working. +1 CON.

events.name: CONTACT WITHIN A MEGACORP
events.text: Coordinate with your GM to establish a specific corporate contact for insider information or backchannel favors. The first favor: one entry roll is waived.

events.name: LUCKY STIFF
events.text: Win a small fortune on the lottery. Raise Credit Score by 5.

events.name: RELATIVE WITHIN THE POLICE DEPARTMENT
events.text: Trouble with the law are now resolved.

events.name: RESISTANT TO PAIN
events.text: Add +3 to your maximum HP.

events.name: SOLE HEIR TO WEALTHY AUNT
events.text: Your aunt left you everything she had. +6 Credit Score.

events.name: GIFTED STUDENT
events.text: Add +1 to INT or WIS. A scholarship is waiting: one entry roll for a Student career is waived.

events.name: GIFTED BODY
events.text: Add +1 to any base attribute.

events.name: COMMANDO TRAINING
events.text: Elite-forces commando training as a teenager: +1 STR, DEX and MST, +2 Credit Score, and the Military Academy credential.
